requirements: Base allows nonempty actors and outcomes. Left alone narrows actor to Clerk. Right alone narrows outcome to indexed. Candidate applies both restrictions.

Success assigns absent owner, preserves present owner and ordered acceptance, changes Ready to Filed and increments exact uint64 revision. Guard refusal retains complete task and T_file, with sorted guard IDs.
Check does not execute. Execute runs base, left, right, candidate only while all preflights current and prior receipts matched, cleaned and context live.
Conflict and invalid combination expose no candidate or proposal preflights. Failure, mismatch, cleanup uncertainty and cancellation preserve reached receipts and suppress subsequent execution.
